verdict.rationale: Shared inboxes are a fair axis for an email product, but the pack contains no evidence of shared mailboxes or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state. The only related item is delegated send-on-behalf (outlook-docs-9), an adjacent permission feature that does not give a team shared conversation state, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
